notices.html: Most pick-your-own farms have wound down for the season: Terhune's and Von Thun's fall festival weekends have wrapped up, and this spring's freeze means there's no apple picking at all at Terhune or Battleview this year. Call ahead before driving to any PYO farm this weekend.
Diggerland's Diggerfest wraps up this weekend (through Nov 15), weekends only and included with general admission, so this is close to the last easy chance before the park's winter break.

Polar Express train rides now have confirmed 2026 dates at both Whippany (Morristown & Erie Railway) and Phillipsburg (Delaware River Railroad): Nov 27 to 29, Dec 4 to 6, 11 to 13, and 18 to 20. Tickets are already on sale and these sell out early, so book soon if you want a date.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: the Fall Family Fun festival is done for the year, but the Winery Weekend Music Series continues Saturdays and Sundays in November, noon to 5pm with live music 1 to 4pm at the vineyard tasting room. The farm market and bakery stay open daily, and there's still no apple picking this year after the spring freeze. Call 609-924-2310 to check what's left to pick.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: no confirmed update from the farm itself, so call 609-448-0629 before you go. Thanksgiving turkey orders are picking up (the farm fills around 1,000 of them most years), and you can pick fresh vegetables in person while you're there to order yours.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: the Monmouth Junction Fall Festival Weekends have typically run through late October to early November, so the ticketed festival and corn maze are likely over for the season, leaving just the farm market open. Call 732-329-8656 to confirm before you drive over.
blurbs.emerys: This weekend: no confirmed update this week. Berries are long done, and the corn maze and pumpkin picking have run into fall in past seasons. Call the picking hotline at 609-758-8514 or check emerysfarm.com before you go.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: there's still no apple picking at all after the spring freeze wiped out the whole crop, the farm's first total loss in five generations. The year-round country store stays open daily with its own apple cider donuts, made from sourced apples, though fresh-pressed cider is seasonal and may not be running. Call 732-462-0756 before you drive over.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: no confirmed November update from the farm. In past years the holiday season, with Santa and lights, kicks off in late November, so gem mining, the corn maze and sunflowers may already be winding down for the year. Call 609-654-8643 before you go.
blurbs.diggerland: This weekend is the last call for Diggerfest this season: weekends only, running through Nov 15, included with general admission. Check the park's own calendar for current hours before you drive down.
blurbs.sixflags: Fright Fest and Kids Boo Fest are done for the year, and it's quiet there this particular weekend. Holiday in the Park returns with a season passholder preview night on Nov 20 and opens to everyone on Nov 21. Check sixflags.com/greatadventure for hours and tickets.
